subject.title: fix(sessions): enforce exact owner equality for all parent session use

question: Does the contributor's exact-head evidence sufficiently demonstrate the real gateway security boundary, or must they provide a live RPC transcript or runtime log before merge?
rationale: The patch is statically correct and CI is green, but repository policy makes after-fix real behavior proof a merge gate for external non-docs PRs, especially for a transcript-isolation boundary.

options.title: Require live gateway proof
options.body: Ask for redacted exact-head gateway RPC or runtime output showing the denied and allowed owner cases before merge.

options.title: Accept the submitted evidence
options.body: Treat the direct-handler observations and exact-head regression suite as a maintainer proof override for this narrowly isolated service change.

recommendation.title: Require live gateway proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted exact-head gateway RPC or runtime output showing the denied and allowed owner cases before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged history is most directly connected to the session parent-link and lifecycle behavior being secured.
